resources.string: Your computer works. You stay connected.

On your computer, open Settings → H5 access and scroll to Phone app · Remote access. Enable public access, wait for Online, then select Connect phone and scan with this app. The separate H5 access switch is for local networks and can stay off.
Identity pairings reconnect automatically. Temporary pairings require a fresh scan after address or phone network changes. Keep your computer running and online.

1. Open Settings → H5 access on your computer, scroll to Phone app · Remote access and enable public access.
2. Once Online, select Connect phone to generate a QR code.
3. Scan with this app, then approve the phone on your computer.

The separate H5 access switch is for devices on the same local network. Remote phone access does not require it.

Sessions run on your computer, including while the phone is in the background. This version has no background push notifications. Returning to the app restores session state.

Each computer has separate cookies and website data. Removing it clears the corresponding credentials on this phone. You can also revoke the device on your computer. New pairings use a secure device key to verify and reconnect after address changes. Older records need one new QR scan.
This pairing code could not be read. Scan the phone pairing QR on your computer or paste its complete HTTPS /remote pairing link.
This code differs from the saved computer identity or connection service. Check which computer generated it before pairing.
Scan the pairing QR code in Phone app · Remote access on your computer
Remove this computer and its sign-in credentials from this phone. Sessions on your computer will keep running.
Website data is still in use. Close and reopen the app, then try removing it again.
Address copied without the pairing secret
Connection unavailable. The app will try to discover and verify the computer again. You can also retry.
Follow the page to pair, then approve this device on your computer.
Update Android System WebView first. This version cannot isolate computer data, so a secure connection is unavailable.
Your computer was saved, but the phone web component could not open. Update Android System WebView, then tap Refresh to retry.
Could not read your computer list. Original data was preserved. Check storage space and try again.
Could not save. Check available storage and try again.
Your system cannot open this action right now.
Temporary connection · Scan a fresh computer QR
Pairing revoked or unavailable · Scan again
Computer identity could not be verified · Connection stopped
Online · Temporary pairing (rescan if address changes)
Keep your computer running. Pick up where you left off.
